title: Band-Edge Homogenization and the Sound-Soft Limit of Finite Bubbly Crystals
summary: We establish a quantitative sound-soft scattering limit for a finite bubbly crystal near the upper edge of the first Bloch band of the corresponding infinite crystal. The inclusions form a dense periodic array of period $\varepsilon$ in a bounded Lipschitz domain, and their density contrast is $δ=\varepsilon^2$, with fixed positive wave speeds. Under coordinate-reflection symmetry, we prove that the normalized capacitance symbol has a unique nondegenerate maximum on the Brillouin torus.
